GRADE [C] H1 repaired and demonstrated: error markers are set unconditionally and appending a binder never clears a recorded error, so BINDER lines followed by ERROR <decl> boom now yields FAIL: ERROR boom (v3's setdefault would have dropped it).

GRADE [C] H2 repaired and demonstrated: every malformed line is a FAIL counted into the total; a truncated BINDER record now yields MALFORMED line N and malformed=1 with a non-zero exit. An over-reach found while testing (the legitimate DECL line was first flagged) was fixed so only unrecognised lines fail.
GRADE [C] H3 repaired and demonstrated: an implicit binder that is not an expected type binder now yields EXTRA IMPLICIT BINDER Q : Fin 2 and FAIL, instead of a mere label.

GRADE [C] H4 repaired and demonstrated: instances are compared as Counter multisets in both directions, so a duplicated MeasurableSpace X with MeasurableSpace Y dropped yields UNKNOWN/EXTRA INSTANCE MeasurableSpace X (x1) and FAIL, which set membership would have missed.
GRADE [C] v4 also checks consecutive binder indices 0..n-1, type-binder indices and universe strings, the exact explicit sequence, the total binder count and each declaration's instance count.

GRADE [C] Expectations FROZEN from the transcribed supervisor-verified summary (capture/real_summary.json), with no hand-entered values: total binders 31, 31, 33, 12, 12, 14 and instances 8, 8, 8, 3, 3, 3; no StandardBorelSpace Y and no Nonempty Y in any declaration.
